<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#23262E"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#181A20"/>

    <linearGradient id="accent" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#A06AF9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FBA3FF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="mint" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#B4DDDD"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#97DAA4"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="22" y="25" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
    <line x1="318" y1="20" x2="318" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="323" y1="18" x2="323" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="328" y1="16" x2="328" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="341" cy="21" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="345" y1="25" x2="348" y2="28" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="356" y="16" width="20" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="358" y="18" width="15" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="377" y="20" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="31,64 23,72 31,80" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

    <text x="58" y="78" font-family="Poppins" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Notifications</text>
    <circle cx="350" cy="71" r="20" fill="#262A34"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="66" r="5" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="77" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#FBA3FF"/>

    <text x="363" y="62" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#181A20">3</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Filter row -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="116" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">Recent activity</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="302" y="96" width="68" height="30" rx="15" fill="#262A34" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
      <line x1="316" y1="106" x2="328" y2="106" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="318" y1="111" x2="326" y2="111" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <line x1="321" y1="116" x2="323" y2="116" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="335" y="116" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#DADADA">Filter</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Notification 1 -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="140" width="354" height="101" rx="18" fill="#000000" opacity=".18"/>
    <rect x="18" y="138" width="354" height="101" rx="18" fill="#262A34"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="174" r="22" fill="#A06AF9"/>
    <text x="52" y="180" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">EM</text>
    <circle cx="68" cy="190" r="6" fill="#97DAA4" stroke="#262A34" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="86" y="163" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Elena Martinez</text>
    <text x="86" y="184" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">mentioned you in a comment</text>
    <text x="86" y="207" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">“The new project brief is ready to review.”</text>
    <text x="329" y="163" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#8E96FF">2m</text>
    <circle cx="348" cy="216" r="4" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Notification 2 -->
  <g>
    <line x1="28" y1="257" x2="362" y2="257" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="292" r="22" fill="#FF968E"/>
    <text x="52" y="298" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">JR</text>
    <circle cx="68" cy="308" r="6" fill="#97DAA4" stroke="#181A20" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="86" y="281" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Jordan Reed</text>
    <text x="86" y="302" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">sent you a new message</text>
    <rect x="86" y="313" width="238" height="28" rx="10" fill="#353843"/>
    <text x="98" y="332" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Can we sync on the launch timeline?</text>
    <text x="352" y="281" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#8E96FF">18m</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Notification 3 -->
  <g>
    <line x1="28" y1="366" x2="362" y2="366" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="400" r="22" fill="#B4DDDD"/>
    <text x="52" y="406" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">NS</text>
    <text x="86" y="389" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Noah Singh</text>
    <text x="86" y="410" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">replied to your message</text>
    <text x="86" y="432" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">“I added the notes to the shared workspace.”</text>
    <text x="352" y="389" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#8E96FF">1h</text>
    <circle cx="348" cy="426" r="4" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Notification 4 -->
  <g>
    <line x1="28" y1="458" x2="362" y2="458" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="493" r="22" fill="#FFDD72"/>
    <text x="52" y="499" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">AC</text>
    <circle cx="68" cy="509" r="6" fill="#97DAA4" stroke="#181A20" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="86" y="482" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Ava Chen</text>
    <text x="86" y="503" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">mentioned you in “Design review”</text>
    <rect x="86" y="514" width="196" height="28" rx="10" fill="#353843"/>
    <text x="98" y="533" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Your feedback looks great!</text>
    <text x="352" y="482" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#8E96FF">3h</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Notification 5 -->
  <g>
    <line x1="28" y1="567" x2="362" y2="567" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="602" r="22" fill="#97DAA4"/>
    <text x="52" y="608" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">LT</text>
    <text x="86" y="591" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Lucas Thompson</text>
    <text x="86" y="612" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">sent you a direct message</text>
    <text x="86" y="634" font-family="Inter" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">Yesterday · 4:36 PM</text>
    <text x="352" y="591" text-anchor="end" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">1d</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Activity summary card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="671" width="354" height="54" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity=".18"/>
    <rect x="18" y="669" width="354" height="54" rx="16" fill="#200E32"/>
    <circle cx="46" cy="696" r="13" fill="url(#accent)"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="689" x2="46" y2="703" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="39" y1="696" x2="53" y2="696" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="70" y="694" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">You’re all caught up</text>
    <text x="70" y="711" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#DADADA">No more notifications for now</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="748" width="390" height="96" fill="#181A20"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="748" x2="390" y2="748" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>

    <text x="49" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Home</text>

    <rect x="191" y="775" width="16" height="16" rx="7" fill="none" stroke="#FBA3FF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="199" cy="772" r="3" fill="#FBA3FF"/>
    <line x1="195" y1="795" x2="203" y2="795" stroke="#FBA3FF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="211" cy="770" r="5" fill="#FF7A55"/>
    <text x="211" y="773" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="8" font-weight="700" fill="#181A20">3</text>
    <text x="199" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Alerts</text>
    <!-- Chat -->
    <rect x="270" y="774" width="22" height="16" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="275,790 275,794 280,790" fill="#5E6272"/>
    <line x1="276" y1="780" x2="286" y2="780" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="281" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Chat</text>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="348" cy="780" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="348" cy="777" r="3" fill="#5E6272"/>
    <ellipse cx="348" cy="785" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#5E6272"/>
    <text x="348" y="813" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#5E6272">Profile</text>
    <rect x="164" y="834" width="62" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
</svg>
